The Owls, led by 2nd-year head coach [[Amir Abdur-Rahim]], played their home games at the [[KSU Convocation Center]] in [[Kennesaw, Georgia]] as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]]. They finished the season 5-19, 2-13 in [[2020–21 ASUN Conference men's basketball season|ASUN Play]] to finish in last place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 ASUN men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]] to [[2020–21 Liberty Flames basketball team|Liberty]]. ==Previous season== The [[2019–20 Kennesaw State Owls men's basketball team|Owls]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 1–28, 0–16 in ASUN play to finish in last place. In turn, they failed to qualify for the [[2020 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|ASUN tournament]].{{Cite news|url=https://ksuowls.com/sports/mens-basketball/schedule/2019-20|title=2019-20
